Definition: a vine blossom; used also adverbially, abloom
KeyPassages: Song of Solomon 2:13; Song of Solomon 2:15
BiblicalUsage: The word çᵉmâdar is a vine blossom, abloom. You meet it in Song of Solomon, where it does exactly what it sounds like it should do.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that çᵉmâdar shows God wastes no words — every word He gives, including this one, belongs where it is.
